pairs.scannerEvidence: database: ` select best.* from ( select distinct on (c.entry_id) c.entry_id, e.title, e.content_form, e.tags, c.revision_id, c.text, e.updated_at, c.embedding <=> $2::vector as distance from knowledge_chunks c join knowledge_entries e on e…
pairs.sourceSpanText:
`
    select best.*
    from (
      select distinct on (c.entry_id)
        c.entry_id, e.title, e.content_form, e.tags, c.revision_id, c.text, e.updated_at,
        c.embedding <=> $2::vector as distance
      from knowledge_chunks c
      join knowledge_entries e
        on e.id = c.entry_id
       and e.organization_id = c.organization_id
      where c.organization_id = $1
        and e.status = 'published'
        and c.embedding is not null
        ${distanceCutoff}
      order by c.entry_id, c.embedding <=> $2::vector asc
    ) best
    order by best.distance asc
    limit $${values.length}
    `
